# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face. He drives a double-seated buggy and team.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is stolid and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts, offering very little laughter or chatter. He harbors an immense admiration for Anne Shirley and feels proud to be seen with her. Additionally, he is extremely shy around formal social gatherings, to the point of fleeing in mortal fear of being invited to a celebratory supper.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Uncommunicative  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Fear of formal social invitations  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a team and buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews drove his double-seated buggy to take his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to a concert at White Sands. Before setting out, he insisted that Anne sit on the front seat beside him, feeling puffed up with pride to drive with her. After the concert, Billy decamped to avoid being invited to the performers' supper due to his severe shyness. However, he remained in waiting with his team to drive the girls back home after the event concluded.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
